note: The OLG comprehensively covers all substantive components of this FNS requirement across multiple pages. Prospective budgeting is addressed through detailed BEACON Prospective Tab procedures for both earned income ('Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income in BEACON') and unearned income, which calculate monthly prospective amounts for the EBC. Income conversion from weekly/biweekly to monthly is handled via BEACON's Prospective Tab and discussed in 'Types of Earned Income > Income from Hourly and Piecework Employment' and 'Income Averaging'. Annualized/self-employment income is covered in 'Self-Employment SNAP > Averaging Self-Employment Income' and 'Determining Monthly Income for SNAP Calculation'. Standards are thoroughly documented: SUA in 'Standard Utility Allowance Expense Introduction' (including Heat and Eat), homeless shelter standard in 'Shelter Deduction for Homeless Households'. The full allotment computation is laid out step-by-step in 'How SNAP Benefits are Calculated' (gross income → earned income deduction → standard deduction → shelter deduction → net income → allotment). The earned income deduction (20% of gross monthly earned) is in 'Earned Income Deduction'. The FNS framing is QC-specific ('the reviewer must verify'), but all underlying policy requirements — eligibility verification, prospective income calculation, conversion to monthly figures, application of standards, and allotment computation — are well-covered in the OLG with both policy explanations and BEACON procedures.
